# NomadSwipe

> NomadSwipe is a free trip planner app for Android. You swipe through real places in a city, save the ones you like, and see your whole trip on one map. iOS is not available yet.

Get the app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gchertkov.SwipeNomad&referrer=utm_source%3Dllms-txt%26utm_medium%3Dgeo%26utm_campaign%3Dllms

## Pages
- [Home](https://nomadswipe.com/): what the app does, screenshots, FAQ
- [Travel itinerary template](https://nomadswipe.com/itinerary-template.html): free printable day-by-day template with copy-as-text and a Markdown download, no sign-up
- [Alternatives hub](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/): honest comparisons with other trip planners
- [Swipe travel apps compared](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/swipe-travel-apps.html)
- [Schengen 90/180-day calculator](https://nomadswipe.com/schengen-calculator.html): counts Schengen stay days in any 180-day window; planning aid, not legal advice
- [Athens in 2 Days: a Place-by-Place Itinerary](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/athens-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day Athens plan built from 16 places in the NomadSwipe app's Athens data, with a table per day (stored ratings, review counts, addresses) and a method and sample section. Disclosure: I built NomadSwipe (Android).
- [How to Plan a Trip on a Map: 8 Steps for Any App](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/plan-a-trip-on-a-map.html): step-by-step guide to saving places, mapping them and grouping them by day, with a Google Maps / Wanderlog / Mapstr / NomadSwipe comparison table and a 16-place Lisbon worked example.
- [Vienna in 2 Days: a Place-by-Place Itinerary](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/vienna-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day Vienna plan from 16 places in the NomadSwipe app data, a table per day, plus a findings section on gaps in the data
- [Brussels in 2 Days: a Place-by-Place Itinerary](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/brussels-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day Brussels plan from the NomadSwipe app data, a table per day, with a method and sample section
- [Bruges in 2 Days: Stops Matched to Opening Hours](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/bruges-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day Bruges plan of 16 places from the NomadSwipe app data, each stop matched to the weekdays it is open
- [New York City in 2 Days: Stops Matched to Opening Days](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/new-york-city-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day New York City plan of 14 places from the NomadSwipe app data, matched to the weekdays each is open
- [Las Vegas in 2 Days: Stops by Opening Days](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/las-vegas-2-day-itinerary.html): two-day Las Vegas (Nevada) plan of 17 stops from the NomadSwipe app data, checked against opening hours on all seven weekdays
- [How to Find Things to Do in a New City: 7 Steps](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/find-things-to-do-in-a-new-city.html): seven steps for picking places in an unfamiliar city, with a worked example from real stored place data
- [Google Maps Lists Alternatives: 5 Apps Compared (2026)](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/google-maps-lists-alternative.html): Google Maps lists vs Mapstr, Wanderlog, Stippl and NomadSwipe: list limits, sharing, notes, offline use, map view and platforms, read from official pages.
- [How to Save Places on Google Maps (Android and iPhone)](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/save-places-for-a-trip.html): how to save places on Google Maps in 8 steps for Android and iPhone: lists, labels, finding them later, and the limits you hit when planning a whole trip.
- [Free Itinerary Planner App: 9 Free Tiers Compared](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/free-itinerary-planner-apps.html): free itinerary planner apps compared by what the free tier includes and whether each is an online tool or an app: Wanderlog, TripIt, Stippl, Furkot and more.
- [Offline Trip Planner Android: What Works Without Signal](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/offline-trip-planner-android.html): what works offline for trip planning on Android: Google Maps, Wanderlog, Mapstr, Organic Maps, OsmAnd and NomadSwipe, plus a checklist.
- [Turn a ChatGPT Itinerary Into a Map: 6 Steps](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/chatgpt-itinerary-to-map.html): turn a ChatGPT itinerary into a map: copy the places, check they exist and are open, pin them, group by neighborhood, cut backtracking.
- [Budapest Itinerary for 3 Days: Place by Place](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/budapest-3-day-itinerary.html): a Budapest itinerary for 3 days built from 24 places in the NomadSwipe app, with stored ratings, review counts and a table per day.
- [Porto Itinerary for 3 Days: a Place-by-Place Plan](https://nomadswipe.com/alternatives/porto-3-day-itinerary.html): a 3-day Porto itinerary built from 24 places in the NomadSwipe app, with stored ratings, review counts and a table per day.
